NovaMart Refund Policy

Customers may request a refund for eligible purchases.

Refund requests must be verified against the relevant order
and payment records before approval.

Approved refunds are processed according to the applicable
payment-processing procedure.

Support agents must not promise a refund before verification
and approval requirements have been satisfied.

NovaMart Routing Rules

Payments and billing complaints should be handled by
Payments & Finance.

Delivery complaints should be handled by Logistics.

Privacy and account-data complaints should be handled by
Privacy & Compliance.

Technical product or website issues should be handled by
Technical Support.

NovaMart Complaint Handling SOP

Support agents must acknowledge customer complaints.

Agents must collect required information before final
resolution.

If evidence conflicts with the available records, the case
must be escalated according to the applicable escalation
rules.

Customer-facing responses must not contain unsupported
dates, amounts, approvals, or guarantees.
